title: Talos vase
alt: Ancient Greek vase painting showing the bronze automaton Talos collapsing while figures attend him.
caption: Talos on an ancient Greek vase: an artificial guardian imagined long before modern robotics.
teachingUse: Makes the genealogy of artificial servants materially historical and invites students to ask what moral role is already encoded in the guardian.
